In Alviso the following improvements are planned:
Fourth and fifth year funds will be used to complete the storm drainage system in Alviso and improve the streets. In the fourth year, funds are provided for completion of the drainage system for the residential area including drainage of State Street (Essex to Spreckles), Wabash Street (Pacific to Spreckles), Michigan Street (Pacific to Spreckles) and Pacific Street (State to Michigan). Street improvement will also be provided on Wabash Street (200' W of Pacific to Spreckles), Michigan Street (Essex to Spreckles) and Pacific Street (State to Grand).
As previously mentioned, siltation will be shortlived and be a problem only during construction phases as mentioned above.
Comment:
What measures are planned to mitigate the impacts of siltation on water quality?
Response:
In order to minimize siltation rainy season construction should be avoided if possible. Excavation and demolition activities should proceed only as the construction moves ahead. Excavated and cleared areas should not be left cluttered or exposed for long periods of time. Project sites and hauling routes should be swept and cleaned regularly in order to reduce the impact on water quality from sediment and residues.
